decisions.reason: The PETG blank no longer appears on the website, which weakens public commitment, but it is a low-cost addition to an established thermoforming range, so management would likely keep it rather than admit a misstep.
The contrast spray supports intraoral scanning, which is central to the announced digital-manufacturing direction, so weak visibility can be blamed on slow market adoption and the firm would persist.

Custom earmolds are core to the firm's custom-device manufacturing base and were launched as a multi-model line, so sunk investment and strategic fit argue for persistence despite low website presence.
